name: Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) for View-Dependent Encoding
definition: A method using a Variational Quantum Circuit to model view-dependent radiance and opacity for 3D Gaussians, replacing or modulating classical Spherical Harmonics to capture high-frequency specular effects and reduce artifacts.
summary: Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) for View-Dependent Encoding replaces classical spherical harmonics with quantum-inspired entanglement to model view-dependent radiance and opacity for 3D Gaussians.
